rationale.conceptual: The method employs standard first-principles DFT techniques (supercell relaxation, energy calculations, ZPE corrections, NEB) that are well-established yet non-trivial, requiring proper choice of computational parameters and solid-state physics understanding. No novel algorithm, but careful application of known methods.
rationale.execution: The pipeline requires more than 7 independent DFT calculations: perfect supercell relaxation, H interstitial, vacancy relaxation, six separate H-vacancy configurations (n=1..6) with ZPE phonon calculations, and a CI-NEB calculation, plus post-processing to compute trapping energies. The orchestration of these many runs, each with complex input preparation and dependency management, represents a substantial engineering effort.

No novel algorithm, but careful implementation of known techniques.
